'''2007 Maryland State Championship Steve Harpster DS Cloud City: Port Town District''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Port Town District|SE-D-cloudcityporttowndistrict.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' STEVEN HARPSTER
* '''Deck name:''' FUCK SMOKE SCREEN^4
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
